{
  "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema",
  "$id": "metablooms://schemas/ulvrs/v1",
  "title": "ULVRS \u2014 Unified Lossless Versioned Row Schema (v1)",
  "description": "Single row model for code, chats, runs, governance, lint findings, and quality episodes.",
  "type": "object",
  "required": [
    "row_id",
    "row_type",
    "source",
    "identity",
    "payload",
    "context",
    "provenance",
    "timestamps"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "row_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "description": "Deterministic or UUID identifier"
    },
    "row_type": {
      "type": "string",
      "enum": [
        "code_unit",
        "chat_turn",
        "run_event",
        "governance_rule",
        "lint_violation",
        "quality_episode",
        "diff_event"
      ]
